claim: Every admitted mapping preserves the shared modular event semantics.
scope: Proved for the declared finite IR and arithmetic contract.
proof_or_argument: paper/main.tex: semantic-contract lemma and theorem; artifact/proofs/arguments.md sections 1-3
evidence: tests/test_contract.py admission, codec, and semantic cases; main campaign numeric executions; standalone-oracle independent executions
negative_control: Malformed parents, lifetimes, bindings, guards, capacity, and packets are rejected.
nonclaim: No floating-point, sparse-sparse conjunction, replacement, spill, or device claim.

claim: Target-minus-source payload bytes have an exact signed-OR representation.
scope: All supported packet formats and selected hierarchy edge.
evidence: 1,730 main pairs and 256,074 legal masks compare extracted and literal traffic; standalone-oracle independently rechecks all pairs/masks without importing dataflow; adversarial and fresh stress checks add 1,074 and 3,219 level-mask comparisons
negative_control: The standalone oracle has an empty production-implementation import list and recomputes packet and OR semantics.
nonclaim: Only the declared byte metric; no timing or energy.

claim: Exact squared counting completely decides equality over disjoint free/exact-cardinality blocks.
evidence: equal-small/equal-large results; standalone oracle recomputes avoidance/square logic; adversarial check covers 350 random cases; post-freeze stress adds 192 exact-square and 192 self-equality checks
negative_control: Nonzero generated differences, separating witnesses, and the resource-limited 256-group control.
nonclaim: No claim for arbitrary Boolean support formulas.

claim: A failed equality decision constructs a legal separating mask.
scope: Same promise and executable operation budget.
proof_or_argument: paper/main.tex: witness proof following the exact-equality theorem; proofs/arguments.md section 3
evidence: Campaign witnesses rechecked by signature and literal traffic; the 350-case adversarial oracle validates every constructed separating mask; fresh stress covers all nonzero sign classes
negative_control: Self-reduction consistency failure raises an error; malformed equality certificates reject.
nonclaim: No polynomial runtime claim outside the fragment/budget.

claim: An accepted frontier-potential certificate proves the independent caller-supplied upper bound.
scope: Finite admitted instance; complete listed successor relation.
evidence: orders/cliques/main campaign; 14 damaged-proof mutations; adversarial exact-optimum checks in 58 cases; fresh stress verifies 96 certificates; shipped certificate example is accepted by the checker
negative_control: Omitted successors, changed states/rewards/bounds, and missing terminal conditions are rejected.
nonclaim: Certificate may be loose or exponentially large; bounded producer may return unresolved.

claim: The fixed-zero universal upper-bound decision is coNP-complete with eight bytes payload and exact 2:4 blocks.
scope: Unbounded family of finite IR instances; program/control storage may grow.
proof_or_argument: paper/main.tex: fixed-zero hardness theorem; proofs/arguments.md section 5
evidence: 218 reduction pairs, 5,800 masks, capacity 8 bytes; standalone oracle independently replays all; adversarial oracle adds 80 graphs and 16,720 masks
negative_control: All simple graphs through 4 vertices free and through 3 vertices with 2:4 lifting, every nontrivial threshold.
nonclaim: Not a constant-total-memory result; no deployed hardware claim.
maturity: proved + exhaustive bounded validation + separately reimplemented

claim: The implemented local rewrites preserve their stated semantic/movement relation under checked side conditions.
evidence: Positive and side-condition-negative tests in tests/test_contract.py; graph interchange traces are checked against target mappings.
negative_control: Mutated side conditions and unsupported cases reject.
nonclaim: Not complete for all sparse mapping rewrites.

claim: Frozen main campaign agreement covers 1,730 pairs, 256,074 legal masks, and 13,997 numeric codec/execution masks.
scope: Generated finite inputs retained under inputs/.
evidence: results/summary.csv and nine main result JSON files; standalone-oracle independently obtains the same totals from frozen inputs
negative_control: Exact regenerated input bytes and scientific fields must match; timing excluded.
nonclaim: Counts do not establish production-workload breadth.

claim: The independent 2:4 equality family completes at 128 groups and is unresolved at 256 under the frozen operation cap.
scope: Constructed scaling family and 50M charged-operation preflight.
negative_control: 256-group result remains unresolved rather than being lowered or relabeled.
nonclaim: Timing is one-CPU environment evidence, not an asymptotic proof.

claim: Frontier state size is order-sensitive on the constructed family.
evidence: results/orders.csv and certificates.csv/json; grouped 8-group case has 65 states and 1,052 bytes while interleaved has 32,291 states and 924,932 bytes
negative_control: 12/16-group interleaved/shuffled controls hit the layer limit while grouped completes.
nonclaim: No assertion that one heuristic is globally optimal.

claim: Summing local bounds is strictly looser than joint analysis on clique instances.
negative_control: Joint bound and local sum are recomputed for every retained clique.

claim: The fixed-zero reduction implementation matches signature, literal bytes, and the Max-Cut closed form.
evidence: results/reduction.json/csv; inputs/reduction.jsonl; standalone-oracle replays all 5,800 masks; adversarial crosscheck recomputes 16,720 additional masks
negative_control: Every legal mask checked; capacity and maximum event count recorded.
nonclaim: Finite validation complements but does not replace the general proof.

claim: The standalone artifact cleanly reproduces fifteen scientific parts and three validation paths.
scope: Python-standard-library artifact on the intake environment.
evidence: results/reproduction-validation.json; integrity audit, 24 tests in normal and optimized modes, standalone oracle, adversarial crosscheck, fresh reviewer stress, exact regenerated inputs, and 15/15 scientific parts passed
negative_control: Scientific fields and regenerated bytes are compared; swap must remain zero; output directory must not preexist.
nonclaim: Successful execution is not independent peer review or proof-assistant verification.

claim: A second implementation that imports no production dataflow module reproduces all frozen literal/signature, codec, execution, equality, and reduction totals.
scope: Frozen main and reduction inputs only; bounded legal-mask enumeration.
evidence: results/standalone-oracle.json: 1,730 pairs, 256,074 masks, 13,997 codec masks, 218 reduction pairs, and 5,800 reduction masks passed; implementation_imports is empty
negative_control: Independent parsing, admission checks, signed-OR construction, square counting, codecs, execution, and reduction formula; no import of dataflow.
nonclaim: Package-internal second implementation is not external replication or mechanized proof.

claim: Post-freeze fresh-instance and metamorphic tests do not expose generator-specific special casing.
scope: 144 newly generated small mapping pairs under seed 20260921.
evidence: results/reviewer-stress.json: 2,562 masks, 3,219 level-mask checks, 192 exact squares, 96 upper certificates, 3,219 renamings, and 3,219 source/target swaps passed across equal/mixed/one-sided sign classes
negative_control: Fresh generator does not call dataflow.generate; guard renaming and arm swapping enforce invariances.
nonclaim: This is structural stress testing, not an IID held-out workload estimate or proof of production breadth.

claim: Certificate generation and checking expose an order-sensitive size cost, including a large but checkable retained example.
scope: Nine deterministic structured/clique cases; certificate serialization used only as a transparent size proxy.
evidence: results/certificates.json/csv: 9 cases; largest retained certificate 924,932 bytes and 32,291 states; grouped 32-group case uses 3,727 bytes and 257 states
negative_control: Same 8-group mapping is measured under grouped and interleaved orders; checker validates each certificate against the independent requested bound.
nonclaim: No polynomial certificate-size guarantee and no performance extrapolation beyond these cases.

claim: All shipped experiment checks remain active under Python optimization and relevant integer quantities stay within the documented signed-64-bit envelope.
scope: Declared generator ceilings and shipped Python implementation.
implementation: scripts/verify_artifact.py statically forbids assert statements in src/scripts; explicit runtime checks replace optimization-sensitive assertions
evidence: 24 tests under normal and PYTHONOPTIMIZE=1 modes; static source audit; bound derivation records <2^60 conservative coefficient magnitude
negative_control: The verifier fails on any AST Assert in production source or experiment scripts and on non-standard/network imports.
nonclaim: Python integers are arbitrary precision; the signed-64 statement documents portability headroom, not a hardware benchmark.
maturity: proved bound + statically audited + optimized-mode tested
